quotes.thesis: changed the social structure of France to a considerable extent, because it destroyed the legal privileges that defined the old orders, but it did not remove inequalities of wealth
quotes.context: The clergy and nobility held tax exemptions, feudal dues and the best offices, while the Third Estate paid most taxes. The fiscal crisis of the 1780s
quotes.evidence: In 1790 noble titles were abolished and the Civil Constitution of the Clergy made priests state employees, while the sale of Church lands moved property
quotes.analysis: the revolution replaced a society of birth-based orders with one based on law, property and service to the state, while wealth continued to separate classes.

quotes.thesis: changed the social structure of France a lot because it ended the privileges of the nobility and clergy and made people equal under the law.
quotes.context: Before the revolution there were three estates and the first two had privileges such as not paying many taxes.
quotes.evidence: In August 1789 the National Assembly ended feudal privileges... Napoleonic Code of 1804 made everyone equal before the law
quotes.analysis: Because of these reforms, people in France were no longer divided into legal orders, so the social structure changed a great deal.

quotes.thesis: The Revolution changed French society mainly by ending legal privilege, but wealth stayed unequal.
quotes.evidence: The Napoleonic Code of 1804 made men equal in law, yet Napoleon made a new nobility in 1808, so inequality remained.
quotes.analysis: so peasants no longer owed dues to lords

quotes.thesis: in many respects it was never the same again. At the same time some older patterns of life continued

quotes.evidence: The nobles were all executed at the guillotine in 1793, including Napoleon himself
quotes.analysis: So the revolution completely changed society.

quotes.thesis: changed the social structure of France only to a limited extent, because the people who held wealth and influence before 1789 largely remained the leaders afterwards
